purpose: learn convex probabilistic forecast-stacking weights on a tuning split and evaluate the frozen stack on untouched independent validation groups without inheriting calibration claims from member models

data_roles.member_training: fit upstream candidate density models only
data_roles.stacking_tuning: learn convex mixture weights only; may not be reused as final validation
data_roles.conformal_calibration: optional independent split for prediction-set or region calibration after stacking; member-model coverage is not inherited
data_roles.validation: score transferability of frozen stacking weights and may not update weights

stacking_rule.objective: maximize weighted mean log density of the convex mixture on stacking_tuning rows
stacking_rule.optimizer: EM updates for fixed component densities
stacking_rule.candidate_density_requirement: all candidate log densities must refer to the same realized state and density measure

validation_rule.primary_score: held-out stacked log density minus a common training-marginal log density
